app.name: PaperPaw plugin workshop
start.title: Make your own plugin
start.lede: Say what your reader should do differently. An AI writes the plugin and shows it to you on an X4, an X4 Pro and a Boox, right here. No programming needed.
start.placeholder: For example: a calm dark look for reading at night, with wider margins.
start.hint: Write it as you would tell a friend. You can change everything later.
start.ideas.look.text: Margins, rows, headers, corners, light and dark.
start.ideas.look.prompt: A calmer look: wider margins, roomier rows and soft corners.
start.ideas.home.text: Which books, which widgets, in what order.
start.ideas.home.prompt: A home screen with a big clock, the book I am reading and the ones before it.
start.ideas.keys.text: What each button, tap and swipe does.
start.ideas.keys.prompt: Holding the page forward button should switch night mode on and off.
start.ideas.text.text: Larger letters everywhere, for tired eyes.
start.ideas.text.prompt: Larger text in books and menus, with more space between lines.
start.pay.title: Who pays for the AI?
start.pay.key.text: From console.anthropic.com. It stays in this browser and goes only to Anthropic. A plugin like these costs a few cents.
start.pay.key.label: Your Claude API key
start.pay.key.remember.help: Kept in this browser only. Leave it off on a shared computer.
start.pay.quota.text: Coming soon: a monthly amount paperpaw.org pays, for authors who ask for it.
start.pay.local.text: Install the workshop with Docker and use your own key there.
start.needs-key: Enter your Claude API key first.
workshop.saved: a plugin, saved in this browser
workshop.cost: {model} with your key. This plugin so far: {cost}.
workshop.error.key: Anthropic did not accept the key. Check it and enter it again.
workshop.error.rate: Anthropic says too many requests at once. Wait a minute and send again.
workshop.error.network: Anthropic could not be reached. Check the connection and send again.
workshop.error.long: This conversation has become long. Start a new plugin from the files you have, or download them.
workshop.limit: It stopped after many steps. Tell it to go on, or what to change.
